name: agent-rake
description: Zero-dependency CLI that rakes a repository into an agent-ready brief.

scripts.smoke:modes: node ./bin/agent-rake.js --summary --strict --ignore .npm-cache --root . && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --doctor --strict --root . && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --targets && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --completion bash && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --completion powershell && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --github-actions && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --config-example && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --show-config --root . && node ./bin/agent-rake.js --diff --root .
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:modes && npm run brief:check && npm run pack:check
